definitions.major: cycle.major — RV32IM instruction-class column (0-12); see GLOSSARY §RISC-V
definitions.minor: cycle.minor — sub-class within major; kind = major*8 + minor
definitions.success_rate: fraction of sampled steps where get_targets_at_step returned a valid target
definitions.decode_match: decoded (major,minor) from raw instruction word equals trace cycle (major,minor)
